Asset type: one premium game-world environment concept, a new third floating island for the original family rhythm game Radio Archipelago. One single coherent landscape overview image, wide 3:2 composition, NOT a contact sheet, not multiple views.

Primary request: design a beautiful richly detailed original world named "Moon Resonance" (no lettering in the image). A sculpted irregular floating archipelago in luminous lavender blue-hour light. Not dark night: soft warm rim light, clear silhouettes and readable colors. Massive silver-grey and lilac stratified rocky islands with thick natural stone undersides, clustered crags tapering below into a sea of soft volumetric clouds. Lavender grass meadows, small white and periwinkle flowers, a few graceful silvery-leaf trees, an aquamarine moonlit lagoon and cascading waterfalls dropping into the void. A handful of tall pale-amethyst crystalline resonators embedded among real rocky formations, never a neon crystal wall. Beautiful white plaster radio cottages with curved slate/copper roofs, circular speaker windows, brass rails and slender antenna masts. An elegant ring-antenna observatory sits at the upper far ridge. Cozy amber-lit windows and restrained cyan accents connect the architecture to Nori's mint and brass radio equipment. Real texture and lush sculpted foliage; polished stylized physically based lighting, intricate stone, metal, glass and fabric. High-end animated adventure-game art direction, appealing to children and teenagers.

Composition: elevated three-quarter panoramic view showing the WHOLE irregular main island and rock underside plus several secondary floating crags. The route is clearly visible and travels THROUGH the island rather than only around its perimeter. Arrange foreground flower landing -> broad flight across lagoon -> open rocky cleft near a radio cottage -> gradual elevated S-turn between separated resonators -> observatory meadow -> smooth descending S beside a waterfall, curving back toward the starting region for a repeatable loop. Show changes in height naturally, with large-radius left and right arcs. No sharp 90degree corners, hairpins, closed tunnels, low arches, route-crossing bridge obstruction or scenery in the flight corridor.

The actual playable route consists of discrete thick round ceramic levitating mint/aqua tiles with slim warm-gold rims, comfortably spaced, with occasional long rounded capsule supports matching the same ceramic style. Tiles hover clearly 0.7-1metre above ground/water when near a surface and cross open air in the chasm. No continuous dirt, stone or paved road under the route. Tiles are the principal saturated mint elements, and must stay clearly distinguished from lagoon water. Long supports may bend gently in the horizontal plane but are straight in vertical profile; no stairs made from bent long supports. One obvious connected traversable flow; do not create tangles of disconnected tile paths. Leave large open clear space around the player trajectory. Mist below tile height; detailed scenery mainly beside the flight corridor.

A deliberate visual contrast with the existing green forest first island and orange desert oasis second island: this one is silvery lavender, pearl-white, deep periwinkle, restrained aquamarine, and small warm copper/amber highlights. Maintain a sense of joyful exploration, music and a cozy slightly technological fantasy world.
No UI, captions, title, logos, watermarks, extra characters, cats, neon bloom haze, flat low-poly slabs, simplistic circular island or generic satellite-dish sci-fi city.
